sentences.text: Perused the papers.
The allegations as against the   Wakodikar   21. BA 3285-2021.d  that he was found in possession of Vimal Pan Masala which is prohibited in  Maharashtra as per the order of the Food Commissioner.
The contraband  which was found i.e. Vimal Pan Masala was valued at Rs. 1,10,440/-.

Learned Counsel for the applicant submits that the co-accused in the said  case, Gajanan Dnyanba Shinde has been released on bail and that the  allegations as against Gajanan was that he had purchased the contraband  from the applicant and was found selling the same.
The contraband which  was found with Gajanan was valued at Rs. 15,840/-.
Learned Counsel for  the applicant
submits that taking the prosecution case as it stands, no  offence under Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code is disclosed qua the  applicant.
Prima facie, in the facts, it is doubtful whether an offence unde Section 328 of the Indian Penal Code is disclosed qua the applicant.
Rest  of the Sections with which, the applicant is charged are all bailable.
Investigation seems to be almost over.
Learned Counsel for the applicant  states that the applicant has no antecedents.
Statement accepted.

4. Considering the aforesaid, the application is allowed and the  applicant is enlarged on bail on the following terms and conditions :
 ORDER (i) The applicant be released on cash bail in the sum of Rs. 25,000/-, for a period of eight weeks;

6. It is made clear that the observations made herein are prima facie, and the trial Court shall decide the case on its own merits, in accordance with law, uninfluenced by the observations made in this order.

7. All concerned to act on the authenticated copy of this order.
REVATI MOHITE DERE, J.
